summaries.summary: This slide from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow shows significant divestitures between 2000 and 2011, with sales totaling ~17 billion CHF. It highlights divestitures such as Findus EUR (2000), Minag Water GER, and others, alongside acquisitions like Alcon (23% in 2000, 25% in 2008, 52% in 2010). The timeline indicates Findus was divested in 2000, and Alcon was acquired in 2000, 2008, and 2010.
